svg.title: Capability landscape for modern skill evaluation frameworks
svg.desc: An ordinal matrix comparing eleven frameworks across skill identity, stateful execution, trace evidence, executable checks, semantic review, lifecycle observability, and built-in search. The matrix encodes native, strong, adapter, or outside-scope support and does not rank overall product quality.
svg.text: Capability landscape: where each framework is strongest
Documented support as of 2026-08-29. This is a capability map, not a benchmark score.

g.text: Outside the framework's center of gravity

svg.text: Read by column, not by row total: complete skill evolution requires execution, evidence, and promotion controls that often span multiple products.
